extraction_scope.bounded_mechanism_policy: No direct molecular target or direct membrane-disruption assay is promoted beyond source support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary structure/activity evidence supports that D- and unnatural-residue substitutions changed helicity, hydrophobicity, and membrane-mimetic secondary-structure behavior; this is design/mechanistic context, not proof of a single molecular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD/RP-HPLC and LPS/SDS/TFE contexts are indirect membrane-mimetic evidence; no receptor/target-binding assay is reported.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DP06, UP09, UP11-UP15 and related derivatives
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Protease-stability assays support increased resistance for selected D- and unnatural-residue derivatives under trypsin, plasma, and microbial-protease conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Stability data explain proteolytic resistance and degradation characteristics; they do not by themselves establish antimicrobial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DP06 and UP09 in mouse infection/toxicity assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: In vivo figures support bounded efficacy/toxicity evaluation for DP06 and UP09, while the paper discussion frames membrane targeting as lower-resistance rationale without direct molecular-target proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mouse survival and acute-toxicity data are not promoted to direct mechanism; no exact figure point values beyond source-reported text/captions are fabricated.
